forbidden: absence of alternatives read as fault
authority derived from a modal graph
heuristic inference published as proven fact

selection.A_wins: offline latency acceptable and B/C show no proven needed audit capability
selection.B_wins: derived export materially improves query/reconstruction with no runtime authority and no canonical duplication
selection.C_wins: only on proven operational need plus machine-checked absence of any authorization dependency
selection.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE on close/unstable tradeoff, model disagreement or insufficient audit data

sensitivity.rule: any winner flip or unknown cell caps the verdict at INCONCLUSIVE

status_cap: PASS_WITH_LIMITS at most; PASS only for bounded-research-contract completeness, never for production or universal attribution
